Indian Private Banks Face CEO Succession Challenges

Several of India's largest private sector banks, including HDFC Bank and Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, are initiating searches for new Chief Executive Officers following abrupt departures. This leadership shake-up is testing the banks' strategic focus, despite strong balance sheets and historically low bad loan levels. Analysts note that these unexpected exits raise questions about succession planning within the Indian banking sector. The chairman of HDFC Bank has flagged challenges related to succession planning in Indian banks.
